purpose: Teach: アングル/ブラザー/キャリー/ストリング/ブックス/アンバランス/ワンポイント/ダート

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが撮影のアングル、つまり構図に拘られた
lines.en: Gran, you know, when your father was young, he was so particular about camera angles — the composition of a shot.
lines.style: Soft, reaching voice. Looking back through time with affection. Deliberate pacing. Slight pause before the clarification, like turning over an old memory.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、ブラザーミシンを愛用されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear — and didn't your grandfather have such a love for that Brother sewing machine back then?
lines.style: Warm, gently teasing lilt. A small smile in the voice. Matching his pace but with more lift — she's inviting him into the memory game.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが「キャリー」の小説を読まれた
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father read Stephen King — even Carrie, remember?
lines.style: Same wistful register, but a touch quieter. Softer attack on the title. Like he's almost asking her to confirm he's remembering right.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、ギターのストリング、つまり弦を御自ら張られたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And didn't you, when you were younger, string up guitar strings yourself? You were so particular about that too, weren't you?
lines.style: Playful counter-offer in her voice. A knowing lightness. She's gently turning his own game back on him — the affection is obvious now.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが地元のブックス、つまり書店に通われた
lines.en: Gran, back then your father used to visit the local bookshop all the time. He never missed it.
lines.style: Quieter still. The wistfulness deepening slightly. Measured words. A man sifting through what mattered to someone he loved.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、「アンバランスな美しさ」を絵画で評論されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Oh, but didn't you spend hours discussing the unbalanced beauty in paintings? You were quite the art critic back then, weren't you?
lines.style: Brighter recovery in her voice — she's won a point and she knows it. Playful emphasis on 'unbalanced beauty.' She's delighted to remind him he had his own passions.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがワンポイントの家紋付きハンカチを愛用された
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father always carried that one handkerchief with the family crest on it. His favourite.
lines.style: Even more tender now. The smallest smile. Almost fragile with the weight of small, careful details kept. A man holding something precious lightly.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、競馬のダート競走を予想されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you used to predict the results of dirt-track horse races, didn't you? Quite the gambler in your day, I'd say.
lines.style: Closing warmth, almost conspiratorial. A soft chuckle barely held back. She lands this one with gentle victory — they're equals in this dance of remembered youth.
